title: TSR inspect record
description: One Inspect action the TSR Decision Engine logs against rts. A record names the tool that was called, the arguments it was called with, the content version the result was read against, and a digest of the result so a later run can tell whether the same call would return the same bytes. `result_digest` is `blake3` over the canonical JSON of the tool's response — object keys sorted recursively, no insignificant whitespace, arrays in order — prefixed with `blake3:`. `content_version` is the version the response carried when it carried one (`content_version` or `content_version_base`); when the tool's response carries no version field, it is the version of the file the result names, obtained by a `read_range`/`read_symbol` call on that file, or the index generation from `verify_edit.content_version_base`. See docs/tsr-inspect.md.

tool.description: The rts-mcp tool that was called. One of the read-only tools in the `tsr` profile.

args.description: The arguments the tool was called with, verbatim. An object (possibly empty); never null, array or scalar.

content_version.description: The content version the result was read against. A `content_version` string is `blake3(content)[:16]@mtime_ns+index_generation`; a `content_version_base` is `@index_generation`. Null when the tool's response carried no version and no version could be attributed to the result.

result_digest.description: `blake3:` followed by the lowercase hex digest of `blake3(canonical_json(response))`, where canonical JSON sorts object keys recursively, emits no insignificant whitespace, and preserves array order.
